note: Prompts drafted at skill-authoring time (Phase 0). evals.prompt: Add the Laurelhurst Theater to the aggregator — their site is https://www.laurelhursttheater.com/
evals.expected_output: Full onboarding: identifies the real showtimes source and platform, probes fetch tiers 0-1 before anything heavier, records fixtures, produces a config-driven adapter (or config row if platform is known), passing parse tests, an eyeballable screening table, TMDB match report, and a registered theater row with a green scrape_run and verified alert wiring.

evals.prompt: can we get cinema 21 in here? cinema21.com i think
evals.expected_output: Same onboarding flow despite the casual phrasing; verifies the actual domain, follows Buy-tickets links to the ticketing platform rather than scraping the marketing homepage, checks robots.txt, and completes the definition-of-done checklist.

evals.prompt: I want to start expanding beyond Portland. Add the Grand Illusion Cinema in Seattle.
evals.expected_output: Creates the new seattle-wa region row first (schema already supports multi-city), sets the theater's own timezone, then runs standard onboarding. No Portland assumptions surface anywhere.
